# Manufacturing Engineer — Figure

---

**Job ID:** Not listed (Greenhouse posting id `4375064006`)
**Date Posted:** Not listed
**Date Applied:** Aug 8, 2026
**Salary Range:** $115,000 – $250,000 (broad posted band)

---

## Job Summary

Figure is an AI robotics company building autonomous general-purpose humanoid robots for home and commercial use, headquartered in San Jose, CA. This role designs the internal build process to scale the robot fleet — from module-level to full robot-system assembly.

---

## What You'll Do

- Set up the internal build line for module-level and full robot-system assemblies.
- Analyze and optimize manufacturing processes for efficiency, quality, and cost; monitor production metrics/KPIs and drive corrective actions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally on manufacturability/DFA; qualify vendors for piece-part and assembly-level manufacturing.
- Set up end-of-line design-validation testing and in-process QC; develop assembly fixturing; specify and procure manufacturing equipment/tools.

### Required Qualifications
- Experience in manufacturing engineering
- Expert knowledge of manual and automated assembly techniques
- Experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) — implementation, integration, optimization
- Expert in 3D CAD software
- Ability to travel up to 40%

Bonus: Bachelor's/Master's in Mechanical, Biomechanical, Robotics, Mechatronics, or similar; CATIA V6 experience; robotics or high-tech industry experience.

### Education
Not required outright; Bachelor's/Master's in Mechanical, Biomechanical, Robotics, Mechatronics, or similar is a bonus qualification.

### Benefits
Total compensation may include additional components/benefits depending on the role; details shared if an offer is extended.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Aug 8, 2026

- **Strong overlap:** BS in Electro-Mechanical Engineering is a close match to the bonus degree list; expert 3D CAD across SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Siemens NX, Autodesk Inventor, and CATIA; fixture and tooling design plus automation equipment development are explicit skills; direct build-line and production-ramp experience (ICARUS-Lite from development through commercialization, POSEIDON generation scaling).
- **Gap:** no explicit Manufacturing Execution Systems (implementation/integration/optimization) experience on record — BOM/ERP oversight (Business Central, a self-developed ERP/CRM with dynamic BOM generation) is adjacent operational-systems experience but not literally MES.
- **Gap:** no CATIA V6 specifically (general CATIA is listed) and no robotics-industry-specific experience — additive manufacturing/prosthetics is the closest adjacent domain, not robotics.

### Now — Aug 22, 2026

No material change — nothing MES-specific or robotics-industry-specific has been added to the record since application, and the skills list hasn't changed since Aug 8, 2026.
